description: Weavify connects you to Bangkok's dining and nightlife. Search restaurants, bars, and nightclubs by area, cuisine, vibe, or price; pull up a venue's full profile, menu, and live availability; then hold and confirm a reservation and get a confirmation code — all without leaving the chat. You can also look up or cancel an existing booking by its confirmation code at any time. Reservations are free; the app does not sell digital goods or process payments in-chat.

defaultPrompt: Find me a fine-dining restaurant in Bangkok for dinner this Friday.
